provider.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina (summer day camps)

extraction.notes: No summer 2027 day-camp details or verified registration-opening dates were found. Facts below describe 2026. Registration listings were not exposed in the fetched Activity Finder text, so prices, fees, availability, and opening dates remain unknown. Adventure Camp's Enka attendance site remains unspecified; its two age-band cards use the district as a provisional site. CILT lists 'Current SDC sites.' without naming individual sites; the non-Beaverdam card is an unresolved site group, not a verified single attendance site. CILT eligibility in its own FAQ is 12–15 at Beaverdam and 13–15 elsewhere, despite related-program teasers saying 12–14. Discovery's own FAQ specifies rising first graders through age 12, despite teasers saying ages 4–13. Hendersonville Discovery has different dates from the general Discovery season. June 19 is closed for the main June–August programs. Scope is the four summer day-camp programs supplied, not the separate half-day or Camp Watia offerings.
